description: This file contains unit tests for version parsing and comparison functions related to the 'OpenClaw' project. It tests functions for parsing version strings, comparing version precedence, checking if versions belong to the same stable family, and warning conditions based on version touchpoints.

methods.name: parseOpenClawVersion
methods.description: Parses a version string into an object with major, minor, patch, revision, and prerelease parts.

methods.name: compareOpenClawVersions
methods.description: Compares two version strings to determine which one is newer or if they are equal.

methods.name: isSameOpenClawStableFamily
methods.description: Determines if two versions belong to the same stable family.

methods.name: shouldWarnOnTouchedVersion
methods.description: Decides whether to issue a warning when a version has been touched or modified.
